title: Melting Clock Tower
description: A surreal painting of a melting Big Ben clock tower with a large human eye and face emerging from its side. The tower is surrounded by flying birds, dripping liquid, green and blue fabrics, and concentric receding square frames under a stormy sky.
prompt: Surreal melting Big Ben clock tower with a giant human eye and face emerging from its brickwork, golden liquid dripping down its sides, surrounded by a flock of blue and green birds in flight, layered concentric square frames receding into the distance, green and blue fabrics floating in the rain, glowing heart shape, stormy atmosphere with smoke and water droplets, intricate symbolic details
